title: Text animations
summary: Title cards and text overlays in the comic sunset look: chunky gradient lettering with a heavy ink outline and hard drop shadow, slanted panel bands with pale gutters, halftone, bursts and brush kickers. Words slam, stretch, rise and scroll.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "field": "sunset"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Fields: sunset, dusk, candy, sea, gold, paper (field and colour names from other themes are mapped onto these). Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "FOCUS", "y": 330}}. Every word, colour and position is a prop. Kit: library/themes/gta6/text/kit.js (style lives in its `theme`). Files: library/themes/gta6/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline slam
items.description: A headline slamming in letter by letter on a slanted panel band, with a brush kicker and a note.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two words stacked across a slanted gutter, sliding in from opposite sides around a small illustrated panel.

items.name: Marquee wall
items.description: A tilted wall of sign strips that never stop scrolling, alternating direction and colour.

items.name: Statement
items.description: A sentence rising word by word over the turning backdrop; the words you pick come up in the hot gradient.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One enormous figure slammed onto a turning inked burst, with a kicker tab and a label.

items.name: Quote card
items.description: A quotation in a comic speech bubble, the words landing one at a time, the speaker named below.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: A title and a numbered plan dealt in as slanted strips, one step at a time.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two words charging in from opposite sides across a slanted gutter, a badge bursting on the seam.

items.name: Chapter opener
items.description: A giant numeral with a brushed kicker across it and the title on a slanted band.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Each number slams in on its own colour field with a burst, then the go word.

items.name: End card
items.description: Closing lines, a call to action and a handle plate over a marquee strip that keeps running.

items.name: Follow card
items.description: A slanted dusk plate with a sun monogram and the handle in chunky lettering; the pink FOLLOW tab is punched and turns into a yellow FOLLOWING tick. Sits on footage.

items.name: Keyword slam
items.description: A slanted gradient band shoots across and one word lands on it letter by letter, with a shake.

items.name: Highlight swipe
items.description: A sentence in outlined capitals; an inked marker bar swipes behind the words you name.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: The speaker's name on a slanted plate with a small sun, the role on a tag.

items.name: Side text
items.description: A slanted sign strip running up one edge of the picture with a tag at its end.

items.name: Marquee band
items.description: A band across the picture that keeps scrolling, with a thinner strip running the other way.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Slanted tabs in the four corners with halftone wedges and a round mark.

items.name: Picture frame
items.description: A comic-panel frame around a picture-in-picture window, with a label and caption tab.

items.name: Sticker
items.description: A starburst sticker slapped on with a wobble, small text running round inside its edge.
